args.title: Fix password reset email using localhost fallback URL in production
args.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever PUBLIC_URL is unset, so the password reset link (and other links built from BASE_URL) point to localhost in production. Ensure the production deployment sets PUBLIC_URL correctly, and/or change this fallback to fail loudly or use a proper production default instead of silently defaulting to localhost.
